title: 1:1 controls polish & workback scratchpad
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Priya (security lead) — controls polish + vendor surfacing
Date: Fri 2025-02-21 (prep before EOD Thu 2025-02-20)
Duration: 30m
Goal: align on which controls we will table for the upcoming readiness run, decide final evidence owners, and agree on a short workback for the mini dry-run (internal).

Context / why this matters:
- Audit window targeted for Q2 readiness dry-run; we want a small internal run to catch evidence gaps and timing issues.
- Current gap list (from checklist run 2025-01-30) still has ~12 items flagged as "partial" or "not started". Prioritise high-risk controls (access, change mgmt, vendor oversight).
- Need a crisp owner list and clear evidence naming convention so SRE/product teams can hand artifacts without extra back-and-forth.

High-level agenda (30m):
1) Quick status (5m) — what changed since the last pass (Priya)
2) Walk top 6 risk controls (15m) — decide: ready / partial / escalate
   - Access provisioning (user lifecycle) — evidence: onboarding/offboarding tickets + IAM snapshots
   - Privileged access reviews — evidence: reviewer attestation logs
   - Change management for infra — evidence: change tickets + rollback test notes
   - Vendor risk (third-party infra) — evidence: vendor contracts + penetration attestations + SOC2/ISO reports
   - Data retention & encryption — evidence: config snippets (KMS), retention policy doc
   - Incident response tabletop done? — evidence: tabletop notes + postmortem template filled
3) Workback + owners (8m) — who does what by when
4) Quick Qs / blockers (2m)

Notes-to-self (things I want to raise):
- Ask Priya whether we can accept the vendor's ISO cert copy as interim evidence for the dry-run or require the full bridge letter. (Risk: legal wants contract + attestation for production vendors.)
- Clarify whether Dedicated infra (customer-facing fleet) needs separate privileged access evidence vs internal staging clusters. If so, split owner list.
- Request an example of "attestation language" we want reviewers to sign — keep it short, one-liner is easier to get completed.
- Confirm centralized evidence bucket naming convention (suggest: evidence/{control-id}/{YYYY-MM-DD}/{owner}-{artifact-type}.pdf).

Open control-specific items (quick list with current status):
- AC-01 (user onboarding/offboarding): partial — onboarding tickets exist but offboarding evidence inconsistent (no ticket closure in ~4 cases). Owner: Ben. Action: Ben to run query and close or annotate tickets by 2025-02-24.
- PR-02 (privileged access reviews): not started — need monthly review attestation from infra leads. Owner: Sloane. Action: Sloane to coordinate reviewers and draft attestation email template by 2025-02-23.
- CM-01 (change mgmt): partial — CI/CD changes documented but manual infra changes missing RBAC notes. Owner: Platform Eng lead (TBD). Action: capture 3 recent infra changes and attach runbooks by 2025-02-27.
- VR-03 (vendor evidence): partial — two vendors missing ISO/SOC docs, third vendor only has public SOC2 summary. Owner: Omar (me) to escalate to Procurement with specific ask and deadline 2025-02-25.
- IR-01 (incident response): ready — tabletop ran 2024-12-15, notes uploaded. Confirm: include post-tabletop action list as evidence. Owner: Incident Response lead (Anika).

Immediate prep checklist (what I need to do before the 1:1):
- Pull current gap spreadsheet (Linear/Confluence) and highlight top 6 controls (done).
- Export sample evidence artifacts (3 examples) to sample evidence bucket and share link in meeting (action: upload by 2025-02-20 17:00).
- Draft a one-paragraph explanation for accepting vendor certs vs full reports to discuss with Priya and legal.
- Put together suggested owner mapping for the 12 partial items (send as comment on Confluence page).

Potential discussion outcomes and decisions to push for:
- Agreement to accept "attestation + contract" for low-risk vendors for dry-run, full vendor reports only for high-risk infra providers.
- Finalize owner list and deadline for evidence collection (target 2025-02-28 internal freeze).
- Establish lightweight reviewer attestation template and cadence (monthly).

Follow-ups to create after meeting (post-1:1 action items to track):
- Create Linear tasks for each evidence item with owner and due date (me).
- Email Procurement + Vendor Ops with vendor doc request template (Omar + Ben).
- Book a 60m dry-run slot 2025-03-05 with SRE, Platform, and SecOps (Priya to own calendar invite).
- Update Confluence readiness page with final workback and evidence naming schema (Priya).

Risk notes / escalation triggers:
- If any vendor refuses to provide compliance artifacts by 2025-02-25, loop in legal and procurement immediately; flag for exclusion from production access.
- If >3 infra change items lack runbook or owner, escalate to Platform Eng director for a staffing plan.

Quirky details / heuristics I want to mention:
- For attestation language, recommend: "I confirm I reviewed [control-id] artifacts and attest to their completeness as of [date]." Keep it one sentence to increase completion rates.
- Prefer PDFs for evidence (immutable). If only screenshots exist, request an index file summarizing contents.

Quick links to include during meeting (copy paste):
- Gap spreadsheet (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SEC/SOC2+Gap+Tracker
- Evidence bucket preview (sample): gs://redwood-evidence/samples/controls-2025-02-20/
- Vendor tracker (Sheet): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-VendorTrackerXYZ
- Relevant PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/934

My asks of Priya in the meeting:
- Confirm final "high-risk" control list (I want explicit 1st/2nd priority so I can allocate Ben/Sloane time).
- Approve temporary acceptance criteria for low-risk vendor artifacts for the dry-run.
- Sign off on owner mapping and deadlines so I can create the Linear tasks immediately.

Notes for later (post-dry-run):
- Build an automated evidence collector script (PoC): query Jira tickets, pull attachments, normalize into evidence bucket. Owner: infra-automation team (possible hackweek project).
- Consider adding a "vendor onboarding compliance checklist" into procurement flow to avoid late-stage surprises.

Random scribbles (do not present unless asked):
- Can we reuse the Redwood-verified model on PR review to auto-tag infra PRs that touch sensitive config? (nice to have, not blocker)
- Look into a simple Lambda that zips evidence folder and stamps SHA for immutability.

End of notes — close with action list I will send as follow-up after the 1:1:
- Omar: create Linear tasks + upload sample artifacts (due 2025-02-21)
- Ben: close / annotate missing offboarding tickets (due 2025-02-24)
- Sloane: draft privileged access attestation email/template (due 2025-02-23)
- Priya: confirm high-risk control list + own dry-run invite (due 2025-02-21)

-- Omar
